articles.summary: WD-40 Company (NASDAQ: WDFC) today announced that it has completed the divestiture of the X-14 ® and Carpet Fresh ® brands to Malco Products, Inc. “The decision to divest these brands reflects our continued focus on allocating our time, talent and resources to the opportunities we believe will drive the greatest long-term growth and value creation, particularly across our maintenance products,” said Steve Brass, WD-40 Company’s president and chief executive officer. WD-40 Company will work closely with Malco Products, Inc. to help facilitate a seamless transition. D.A. Davidson served as the Company's financial advisor in connection with the transaction. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed. About WD-40 Company WD-40 Company is a global marketing organization dedicated to creating positive lasting memories by developing and selling products that solve problems in workshops, factories, and homes around the world. articles.summary: WD-40 Company (NASDAQ:WDFC), a global marketing organization dedicated to creating positive lasting memories by developing and selling products that solve problems in workshops, factories and homes around the world, today announced that Steve Brass, president and chief executive officer, and Keith Stauffer, chief financial officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley Global Consumer Retail Conference on Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at approximately 3:00 p.m. ET in New York City. A live webcast of this event will be available on the Company’s investor relations website at http://investor.wd40company.com . The webcast will be archived and available on the website for a six-month period following the conference call.
